concepts.open_problem: Even the leading AI (Philyra) is positioned to AUGMENT perfumer creativity, not automate the sensory call: it predicts raw-material complements, dosage and novelty from 3.5M formulas, but a human perfumer still evaluates and finalizes the scent - leaving the final olfactory judgment as the open human-held step.

concepts.name: Nerikoh (Japanese kneaded incense) blending 'by feel' and maturation judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: Because the amount is adjusted by feel at the fingertips, this step is handled by veteran craftspeople with highly refined skill and intuition.
mechanism_atoms: Powdered aromatics are kneaded with honey/plum and matured in jars; the water/honey amount is adjusted by FEEL at the fingertips according to temperature and humidity, a step handled only by veteran craftspeople, and the months-long commingling/maturation that 'makes' the scent is judged, not measured.
concepts.open_problem: Powdered aromatics are kneaded with honey/plum and matured in jars; the water/honey amount is adjusted by FEEL at the fingertips according to temperature and humidity, a step handled only by veteran craftspeople, and the months-long commingling/maturation that 'makes' the scent is judged, not measured.

concepts.name: Kodo monkoh / kumiko scent-discernment ('listening to incense' and identifying materials)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Kodo is a structured practice focused on sensory discernment, similar to studying music rather than just listening, with every element intended to cultivate a specific quality of attention.
mechanism_atoms: Kodo trains sensory discernment to 'listen to' and distinguish aromatic woods and to identify materials in the kumiko guessing game; it is framed as structured training of attention (like studying music) - a connoisseur discrimination skill with no computational model of the holistic judgment.
concepts.open_problem: Kodo trains sensory discernment to 'listen to' and distinguish aromatic woods and to identify materials in the kumiko guessing game; it is framed as structured training of attention (like studying music) - a connoisseur discrimination skill with no computational model of the holistic judgment.

concepts.name: Clay-painted hamon design (differential clay application defining the temper line shape/aesthetic)
concepts.summary_verbatim: The exact line where the thick clay meets the thin clay (or no clay) is where the nioikuchi will form.
mechanism_atoms: The exact line where thick clay meets thin/no clay determines the hamon's artistic shape and the nioikuchi; choosing and applying the clay resist pattern to produce a specific aesthetic line is a bespoke artist judgment with no formalized predictive model. No tool predicts the resulting hamon shape from a given clay application.
concepts.open_problem: The exact line where thick clay meets thin/no clay determines the hamon's artistic shape and the nioikuchi; choosing and applying the clay resist pattern to produce a specific aesthetic line is a bespoke artist judgment with no formalized predictive model. No tool predicts the resulting hamon shape from a given clay application.

concepts.name: Yaki-ire quench-timing by steel color glow (reading blade color in a darkened forge to pick the exact quench moment)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Traditional Japanese swordsmiths perform yaki-ire in a darkened forge so they can read the exact color of the heated steel, and smiths judge temperature by the blade's color glow, requiring exceptional experience to identify the precise moment for quenching.
mechanism_atoms: Smiths judge temperature purely by the blade's color glow in a darkened room, with no thermometer; identifying the precise quench instant is exceptional tacit skill where even masters lose ~1 in 4-5 blades. No vision/AI system replicates this go/no-go judgment.
concepts.open_problem: Smiths judge temperature purely by the blade's color glow in a darkened room, with no thermometer; identifying the precise quench instant is exceptional tacit skill where even masters lose ~1 in 4-5 blades. No vision/AI system replicates this go/no-go judgment.

concepts.name: Hamon attribution / school identification by temper-line appearance (nie, nioi, hataraki reading)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Hamon patterns are unique to each sword and serve as a signature of the swordsmith, showcasing their skill and school of training.
mechanism_atoms: Hamon patterns and internal activities (kinsuji, ashi, sunagashi) act as a swordsmith's signature enabling attribution to schools; expert connoisseurship reading these features is tacit and unautomated. No model reliably attributes a blade to a smith/school from the hamon.
concepts.open_problem: Hamon patterns and internal activities (kinsuji, ashi, sunagashi) act as a swordsmith's signature enabling attribution to schools; expert connoisseurship reading these features is tacit and unautomated. No model reliably attributes a blade to a smith/school from the hamon.

concepts.name: Swordsmith tacit-knowledge transmission under endangerment (apprenticeship-bound craft skill at risk of loss)
concepts.summary_verbatim: The survival of Japanese sword making hinges on the continuity of knowledge, which is primarily facilitated through a demanding apprenticeship system.
mechanism_atoms: Survival of sword making hinges on continuity of knowledge transmitted through a 5-10+ year unpaid apprenticeship; with ~300 licensed smiths and only ~30 full-time, the tacit skill is endangered and there is no codified/captured medium for it. Capturing and transmitting this embodied knowledge is an unsolved problem.
concepts.open_problem: Survival of sword making hinges on continuity of knowledge transmitted through a 5-10+ year unpaid apprenticeship; with ~300 licensed smiths and only ~30 full-time, the tacit skill is endangered and there is no codified/captured medium for it. Capturing and transmitting this embodied knowledge is an unsolved problem.

concepts.name: Centering clay by feel (detecting centered mass via vibration/smoothness sensed through the arm)
concepts.summary_verbatim: You can tell if your clay is centered by resting your right arm on the splash pan and feeling whether the spinning mound is vibrating and bumping, or whether it feels still and smooth as it spins.
mechanism_atoms: Potters judge centering by feeling whether the spinning mound vibrates/bumps versus feels still and smooth; it is the hardest and most important wheel skill, taking months of muscle memory. Current AI can detect wobble but cannot separate poor technique from wheel-head resonance, causing false positives.
concepts.open_problem: Potters judge centering by feeling whether the spinning mound vibrates/bumps versus feels still and smooth; it is the hardest and most important wheel skill, taking months of muscle memory. Current AI can detect wobble but cannot separate poor technique from wheel-head resonance, causing false positives.

concepts.name: Judging clay plasticity / water content by feel (stiffness sensed by hand, not measured)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Although there are a variety of devices employed to gauge stiffness, the usefulness of these is often questioned by experienced people (who prefer simply judging by feel).
mechanism_atoms: Experienced potters do not measure 21% vs 23% water; they judge the needed stiffness by feel because gauge devices are distrusted. Quantifying the 'smooth = just right' tactile setpoint, and the localized inter-particle friction it reflects, is unsolved; consumer moisture meters measure bulk conductivity, not the relevant feel.
concepts.open_problem: Experienced potters do not measure 21% vs 23% water; they judge the needed stiffness by feel because gauge devices are distrusted. Quantifying the 'smooth = just right' tactile setpoint, and the localized inter-particle friction it reflects, is unsolved; consumer moisture meters measure bulk conductivity, not the relevant feel.

concepts.name: Pulling walls to uniform thickness by fingertip feel (sensing wall irregularities and modulating pressure)
concepts.summary_verbatim: To achieve uniform thickness, periodically check by placing a finger on the inside to feel for irregularities, then adjust the pressure accordingly to maintain even thickness throughout.
mechanism_atoms: Even wall thickness is achieved by placing a finger inside to feel irregularities and varying finger pressure (more at the thick base, delicate near the rim); this real-time tactile control loop is learned by muscle memory and is not captured by any sensing/feedback system.
concepts.open_problem: Even wall thickness is achieved by placing a finger inside to feel irregularities and varying finger pressure (more at the thick base, delicate near the rim); this real-time tactile control loop is learned by muscle memory and is not captured by any sensing/feedback system.

concepts.name: Haptic/AI capture of throwing skill (modeling the tactile clay-mechanics judgment for teaching)
concepts.summary_verbatim: No current consumer-grade AI system captures sufficient depth, as most rely on single-point moisture meters calibrated for soil or food — devices that measure bulk electrical conductivity, not localized inter-particle friction.
mechanism_atoms: Computer-vision + neural-net and sensor-fused systems attempt to predict centering success and flag uneven pressure, but no consumer-grade AI captures sufficient depth because it relies on moisture meters calibrated for soil/food that measure bulk conductivity, not localized inter-particle friction. Faithful tactile modeling remains open.
concepts.open_problem: Computer-vision + neural-net and sensor-fused systems attempt to predict centering success and flag uneven pressure, but no consumer-grade AI captures sufficient depth because it relies on moisture meters calibrated for soil/food that measure bulk conductivity, not localized inter-particle friction. Faithful tactile modeling remains open.

concepts.name: Market-abuse alert triage (news-causation / price-sensitivity judgment)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Analysts must conduct an initial assessment of related news during the observation period to determine if a highlighted price move was caused by specific news and its likely price sensitivity, which guides subsequent actions in possible market abuse cases.
mechanism_atoms: Analysts must manually assess whether a flagged price move was caused by specific contemporaneous news and judge its price-sensitivity to decide if an alert is a real STOR candidate; with ~99.99% false-positive rates this initial human triage is the bottleneck and is largely a judgment call ML only ranks, not resolves.
concepts.open_problem: Analysts must manually assess whether a flagged price move was caused by specific contemporaneous news and judge its price-sensitivity to decide if an alert is a real STOR candidate; with ~99.99% false-positive rates this initial human triage is the bottleneck and is largely a judgment call ML only ranks, not resolves.

concepts.name: Spoofing/layering intent determination
concepts.summary_verbatim: Key factors in determining spoofing intent include whether the market participant's intent was to induce others to trade when they otherwise would not, whether the intent was to affect a price rather than change their position, whether the intent was to create misleading market conditions.
mechanism_atoms: Detection of the order-book pattern is automated, but determining trader INTENT (intent to induce others, to move price vs change position, to create misleading conditions) is an irreducible human/legal judgment that surveillance tools only surface evidence for.
concepts.open_problem: Detection of the order-book pattern is automated, but determining trader INTENT (intent to induce others, to move price vs change position, to create misleading conditions) is an irreducible human/legal judgment that surveillance tools only surface evidence for.

concepts.name: Corporate-action free-text interpretation & elective-event decisioning
concepts.summary_verbatim: Globally, it is estimated that 46% of event data is published and received manually, driving unnecessary risk and expense to organizations that process Corporate Action events.
mechanism_atoms: ~46% of event data arrives manually as unstructured free-text offering documents with no uniform structure; firms must independently interpret ambiguous/contradictory terms (and for mandatory-with-choice events make a discretionary election) - a manual interpretive task that resists automation precisely because of inconsistent, non-standard source data.
concepts.open_problem: ~46% of event data arrives manually as unstructured free-text offering documents with no uniform structure; firms must independently interpret ambiguous/contradictory terms (and for mandatory-with-choice events make a discretionary election) - a manual interpretive task that resists automation precisely because of inconsistent, non-standard source data.

concepts.name: Settlement-fail / reconciliation break exception adjudication
concepts.summary_verbatim: Exceptions require manual review to confirm their cause, and their volume and nature are a direct reflection of the health of upstream data quality, integration and matching logic.
mechanism_atoms: ~15% of reconciliations break and require manual review to confirm root cause across confirmation/matching/settlement; lack of standard data drives ~90% of the manual matching effort - the cause-determination on each break is human judgment, not yet ML-resolved.
concepts.open_problem: ~15% of reconciliations break and require manual review to confirm root cause across confirmation/matching/settlement; lack of standard data drives ~90% of the manual matching effort - the cause-determination on each break is human judgment, not yet ML-resolved.

concepts.name: IPO bookbuilding allocation discretion
concepts.summary_verbatim: The hallmark of bookbuilding is that it allows underwriters to condition allocations on information other than the bid, and underwriters use this discretion extensively.
mechanism_atoms: Underwriters allocate shares using discretion conditioned on information beyond the bid (relationship, perceived information quality), so two identical bids get different allocations; this allocation judgment is deliberately human/relational and essentially un-automated (and arguably resists automation by design).
concepts.open_problem: Underwriters allocate shares using discretion conditioned on information beyond the bid (relationship, perceived information quality), so two identical bids get different allocations; this allocation judgment is deliberately human/relational and essentially un-automated (and arguably resists automation by design).

concepts.name: Proxy-voting 'last 10%' contentious-resolution judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: while most items are straightforward, the "last 10%" require judgment and careful documentation.
mechanism_atoms: ~90% of ballot items are routine and policy-automatable, but the 'last 10%' (contested elections, unusual pay plans, contentious shareholder proposals) require case-by-case human judgment linked to policy criteria with documented, reviewable overrides; AI assists research but the contentious call stays manual.
concepts.open_problem: ~90% of ballot items are routine and policy-automatable, but the 'last 10%' (contested elections, unusual pay plans, contentious shareholder proposals) require case-by-case human judgment linked to policy criteria with documented, reviewable overrides; AI assists research but the contentious call stays manual.

concepts.name: ED triage acuity for subjective chief complaints
concepts.summary_verbatim: One study analyzing 21,469 patient encounters found poor to fair interrater reliability between nurse-assigned and algorithm-assigned triage scores, with fewer than half of ED encounters assigned the same score by both.
mechanism_atoms: Triage of subjective complaints (chest pain, dyspnea, undifferentiated pain) relies on nurse intuition/experience and shows poor-to-fair agreement with algorithms (fewer than half of encounters scored the same, high over/under-triage by ML); the subjective-complaint corner is where automation reliably underperforms and bias appears.
concepts.open_problem: Triage of subjective complaints (chest pain, dyspnea, undifferentiated pain) relies on nurse intuition/experience and shows poor-to-fair agreement with algorithms (fewer than half of encounters scored the same, high over/under-triage by ML); the subjective-complaint corner is where automation reliably underperforms and bias appears.

concepts.name: Clinical handoff / SBAR salience-selection (what to hand off)
concepts.summary_verbatim: With each handoff, loss of information and miscommunication is expected due to a large amount of information, high frequency of exchange, and differences in perception of what is important and worth mentioning.
mechanism_atoms: Even with SBAR structure, the human judgment of WHICH information is important enough to transmit (differences in perception of salience) drives omission errors; ~80% of serious errors involve handoff miscommunication and the salience-selection step is essentially un-automated.
concepts.open_problem: Even with SBAR structure, the human judgment of WHICH information is important enough to transmit (differences in perception of salience) drives omission errors; ~80% of serious errors involve handoff miscommunication and the salience-selection step is essentially un-automated.

concepts.name: Diagnostic test-ordering stewardship reasoning (right test, right patient)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Hospitalists often are busy, making a host of decisions simultaneously, have a low knowledge of test characteristics (e.g., sensitivity or specificity), and may be unsure of which test to use.
mechanism_atoms: Current stewardship works mainly via blunt CPOE nudges/hard-stops/education because clinicians have low knowledge of test characteristics; the patient-specific reasoning of which test fits which patient at which time is still human and only crudely supported - nudges work only in low-knowledge/weak-opinion scenarios, not nuanced cases.
concepts.open_problem: Current stewardship works mainly via blunt CPOE nudges/hard-stops/education because clinicians have low knowledge of test characteristics; the patient-specific reasoning of which test fits which patient at which time is still human and only crudely supported - nudges work only in low-knowledge/weak-opinion scenarios, not nuanced cases.

concepts.name: Hospital/ICU discharge-readiness determination
concepts.summary_verbatim: Hospital discharge decisions are now made by physicians based on mainly subjective evaluations of patients' discharge status.
mechanism_atoms: Discharge readiness is commonly decided on mainly subjective physician evaluation with criteria interpreted differently across providers and no established guidelines/ADT policies; ML readiness-prediction exists in research but practice remains subjective, with CDS uptake low or over-relied-upon.
concepts.open_problem: Discharge readiness is commonly decided on mainly subjective physician evaluation with criteria interpreted differently across providers and no established guidelines/ADT policies; ML readiness-prediction exists in research but practice remains subjective, with CDS uptake low or over-relied-upon.

concepts.name: Particle-accelerator online beam tuning by expert operators
concepts.summary_verbatim: Despite efforts to automate beam tuning, the tuning of particle accelerators is to this day often done manually by experienced human operators.
mechanism_atoms: Online tuning across huge parameter spaces with sensitive, coupled beam responses is still done mostly by hand between shifts; operators make structure-aware educated guesses that RL/BO optimizers lack, so reproducibility and optimality remain unsolved.
concepts.open_problem: Online tuning across huge parameter spaces with sensitive, coupled beam responses is still done mostly by hand between shifts; operators make structure-aware educated guesses that RL/BO optimizers lack, so reproducibility and optimality remain unsolved.

concepts.name: Cryo-EM grid-square selection during screening
concepts.summary_verbatim: A microscope operator would scan the grid for promising squares to further image at higher magnifications, though this process can be slow and imprecise since the operator must manually closely examine squares and squares can be overlooked in the interest of time.
mechanism_atoms: Operator manually scans low-mag grid overview and picks which squares (good ice vs thick/broken) to image at high mag; slow, imprecise, squares overlooked under time pressure, and 'good' is empirical/iterative judgment.
concepts.open_problem: Operator manually scans low-mag grid overview and picks which squares (good ice vs thick/broken) to image at high mag; slow, imprecise, squares overlooked under time pressure, and 'good' is empirical/iterative judgment.

concepts.name: Electron-microscope astigmatism correction at high magnification
concepts.summary_verbatim: While many SEMs are now equipped with automated astigmatism correction, there are situations, particularly at high magnification, where there is no substitute for eye-hand coordination to make this important correction.
mechanism_atoms: At high mag there is no substitute for human eye-hand coordination on stigmator/alignment knobs; auto-stigmation exists but fails in the hardest regime, and perception of beam roundness/translational motion varies operator-to-operator.
concepts.open_problem: At high mag there is no substitute for human eye-hand coordination on stigmator/alignment knobs; auto-stigmation exists but fails in the hardest regime, and perception of beam roundness/translational motion varies operator-to-operator.

concepts.name: LC-MS / MRM peak-picking manual curation
concepts.summary_verbatim: Despite various software solutions and advanced algorithms are available for MRM data analysis, the manual inspection process still remains a time-consuming and labor-intensive task.
mechanism_atoms: Core peak-picking algorithms remain imperfect (poor separation, noise, baseline, peak shape) so every assignment needs manual inspection; not feasible at hundreds-thousands of metabolites, and batch manual-QC tooling is weak.
concepts.open_problem: Core peak-picking algorithms remain imperfect (poor separation, noise, baseline, peak shape) so every assignment needs manual inspection; not feasible at hundreds-thousands of metabolites, and batch manual-QC tooling is weak.

concepts.name: Telescope real-time project-switching / weather-band decision
concepts.summary_verbatim: Judging when to switch projects based on changing conditions is left to the telescope scheduling staff and observing team to decide.
mechanism_atoms: Static queue optimization is automated, but judging when to switch projects as conditions change (and reacting to ToO triggers within weather bands) is left to scheduling staff / observers in real time.
concepts.open_problem: Static queue optimization is automated, but judging when to switch projects as conditions change (and reacting to ToO triggers within weather bands) is left to scheduling staff / observers in real time.

concepts.name: Sequencing-run QC interpretation & rerun-eligibility judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: When quality control flags indicate "Warn" or "Fail" results, researchers must stop and consider what those results mean in the context of the particular sample and sequencing type used.
mechanism_atoms: FastQC-style flags only output Warn/Fail; the human must decide whether a run truly failed for THIS sample/application and whether a rerun is warranted - in-context interpretation, not just metric thresholds, is unautomated.
concepts.open_problem: FastQC-style flags only output Warn/Fail; the human must decide whether a run truly failed for THIS sample/application and whether a rerun is warranted - in-context interpretation, not just metric thresholds, is unautomated.

concepts.name: Contract redlining / fallback-position judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: Redlining requires deep contextual understanding of your company's risk tolerance, negotiation strategy, fallback clauses, and commercial priorities, and general purpose tools like ChatGPT lack this embedded knowledge and cannot reliably replace a lawyer's judgment.
mechanism_atoms: AI flags non-standard clauses and drafts redlines, but choosing the actual fallback/escalation position requires embedded knowledge of the company's risk tolerance, negotiation strategy, relationship history and commercial priorities that tools cannot access.
concepts.open_problem: AI flags non-standard clauses and drafts redlines, but choosing the actual fallback/escalation position requires embedded knowledge of the company's risk tolerance, negotiation strategy, relationship history and commercial priorities that tools cannot access.

concepts.name: Regulatory benefit-risk narrative synthesis (FDA/EMA submissions)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Medical writers handle high-judgment sections such as benefit-risk assessments, integrated analyses, and complex safety issues.
mechanism_atoms: AI drafts ~40% (routine tables/boilerplate); the high-judgment benefit-risk story, integrated safety synthesis and cross-module justification - plus catching when AI output is simply wrong - stays with seasoned regulatory writers.
concepts.open_problem: AI drafts ~40% (routine tables/boilerplate); the high-judgment benefit-risk story, integrated safety synthesis and cross-module justification - plus catching when AI output is simply wrong - stays with seasoned regulatory writers.

concepts.name: Sanctions-hit adjudication on ambiguous / transliterated names
concepts.summary_verbatim: Identity verification, confirming your customer isn't the sanctioned person, requires human judgment on ambiguous cases.
mechanism_atoms: Fuzzy matchers flood analysts with partial/ambiguous hits driven by transliteration, name reversal, phonetics and cultural variation; the true-match vs false-positive call requires human cultural/linguistic judgment and identity verification.
concepts.open_problem: Fuzzy matchers flood analysts with partial/ambiguous hits driven by transliteration, name reversal, phonetics and cultural variation; the true-match vs false-positive call requires human cultural/linguistic judgment and identity verification.

concepts.name: Subjective intent/foul disciplinary judgment for referees
concepts.summary_verbatim: foul-play situations require subjective evaluations to determine the intentionality of the offence and the disciplinary sanction for the offending player
mechanism_atoms: AI handles objective calls (offside, line, ball-tracking) but determining intentionality of a foul and the appropriate disciplinary sanction remains a manual subjective judgment; VAR has not eliminated controversial decisions and no tool decides intent.
concepts.open_problem: AI handles objective calls (offside, line, ball-tracking) but determining intentionality of a foul and the appropriate disciplinary sanction remains a manual subjective judgment; VAR has not eliminated controversial decisions and no tool decides intent.

concepts.name: Youth talent identification / projection beyond the scout's eye
concepts.summary_verbatim: there is poor inter-coach agreement in the identification of talented athletes
mechanism_atoms: Forecasting which youth athletes will succeed is still mostly subjective expert judgment with poor inter-scout agreement and heavy maturation/relative-age bias; no reliable model decomposes the holistic projection.
concepts.open_problem: Forecasting which youth athletes will succeed is still mostly subjective expert judgment with poor inter-scout agreement and heavy maturation/relative-age bias; no reliable model decomposes the holistic projection.

concepts.name: Individualized daily-readiness load adjustment / periodization
concepts.summary_verbatim: Traditional approaches to training load management predominantly rely on subjective assessments, empirical experience, and standardized protocols
mechanism_atoms: Training load and periodization still rely on subjective RPE/empirical experience; standardized %1RM and linear models fail to respond to an athlete's daily readiness, leaving the day-to-day adjustment a coach judgment call.
concepts.open_problem: Training load and periodization still rely on subjective RPE/empirical experience; standardized %1RM and linear models fail to respond to an athlete's daily readiness, leaving the day-to-day adjustment a coach judgment call.

concepts.name: Out-of-plane movement-fault diagnosis from single-camera video
concepts.summary_verbatim: movement assessment decisions are still largely made through subjective visual assessment
mechanism_atoms: Markerless pose estimation works for single-plane movement but misses 3D compensations; aberrant-movement diagnosis is still largely subjective visual assessment by coaches/physios needing activity-specific multi-camera models that don't exist for most settings.
concepts.open_problem: Markerless pose estimation works for single-plane movement but misses 3D compensations; aberrant-movement diagnosis is still largely subjective visual assessment by coaches/physios needing activity-specific multi-camera models that don't exist for most settings.

concepts.name: Supply-chain exception resolution (MRP/PO exceptions)
concepts.summary_verbatim: the exception resolution process is very tedious and often consumes most of the planner's week
mechanism_atoms: MRP runs produce thousands of exceptions; planners review, consolidate in spreadsheets, email suppliers and chase by phone, consuming most of the week - the prioritization and resolution judgment is manual.
concepts.open_problem: MRP runs produce thousands of exceptions; planners review, consolidate in spreadsheets, email suppliers and chase by phone, consuming most of the week - the prioritization and resolution judgment is manual.

concepts.name: Long-tail / intermittent-demand SKU forecasting
concepts.summary_verbatim: it is very difficult to predict when the next demand will occur and how big it will be
mechanism_atoms: 95%+ of SKUs have intermittent demand with many zero periods; classic and Croston-based models can't reliably set safety stock, so planners make manual overrides and the mix stays wrong (over/understocked).
concepts.open_problem: 95%+ of SKUs have intermittent demand with many zero periods; classic and Croston-based models can't reliably set safety stock, so planners make manual overrides and the mix stays wrong (over/understocked).

concepts.name: Returns disposition decision for ambiguous/complex categories
concepts.summary_verbatim: Manual returns processing requires workers to open boxes, inspect items for damage, verify serial numbers, and make subjective decisions about the item's next destination
mechanism_atoms: Workers still open boxes, inspect for damage, verify serials and make subjective next-destination calls; automated visual grading is emerging but final disposition for complex items (e.g. electronics) stays manual.
concepts.open_problem: Workers still open boxes, inspect for damage, verify serials and make subjective next-destination calls; automated visual grading is emerging but final disposition for complex items (e.g. electronics) stays manual.

concepts.name: Ambiguous receiving discrepancy / damaged-goods exception calls
concepts.summary_verbatim: While a Warehouse Management System significantly reduces inventory discrepancies, it cannot eliminate them entirely
mechanism_atoms: At inbound receiving, deciding accept/reject/quarantine on damaged or PO-mismatched goods is a worker judgment call documented with photos and notes; WMS reduces but cannot eliminate these discrepancy decisions.
concepts.open_problem: At inbound receiving, deciding accept/reject/quarantine on damaged or PO-mismatched goods is a worker judgment call documented with photos and notes; WMS reduces but cannot eliminate these discrepancy decisions.

concepts.name: Open-ended rubric calibration & confidence-gated routing
concepts.summary_verbatim: When AI systems were delivered with stricter confidence filtering settings to achieve human-level accuracy, roughly 70% of items still needed to be graded by humans.
mechanism_atoms: Even with LLM-as-judge, pedagogically rich/ambiguous open responses must be routed to humans; calibrating rubrics against expert standards and deciding the confidence threshold for human escalation is still a manual judgment loop.
concepts.open_problem: Even with LLM-as-judge, pedagogically rich/ambiguous open responses must be routed to humans; calibrating rubrics against expert standards and deciding the confidence threshold for human escalation is still a manual judgment loop.

concepts.name: Student misconception diagnosis (definition/granularity)
concepts.summary_verbatim: A misconception is ambiguous to define, with the granularity and scope of a misconception often making detection an ad-hoc and intuition-driven process.
mechanism_atoms: Identifying the specific misconception behind a wrong answer remains ad-hoc; misconceptions overlap and are ambiguous to define, so discovery still needs experts inspecting student-work traces or interviews.
concepts.open_problem: Identifying the specific misconception behind a wrong answer remains ad-hoc; misconceptions overlap and are ambiguous to define, so discovery still needs experts inspecting student-work traces or interviews.

concepts.name: Viva voce / oral-exam authenticity & competence judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: Two problems with the use of viva voce examinations is their lack of scalability and their subjectivity.
mechanism_atoms: Live oral defense to judge originality AND grasp simultaneously is inherently subjective and unscalable; examiners adapt follow-up questions in real time and weigh communication/ethical judgment - not automated, only simulated for practice.
concepts.open_problem: Live oral defense to judge originality AND grasp simultaneously is inherently subjective and unscalable; examiners adapt follow-up questions in real time and weigh communication/ethical judgment - not automated, only simulated for practice.

concepts.name: AI-authorship / plagiarism authenticity nuance adjudication
concepts.summary_verbatim: Research from Stanford University found that AI detectors misclassified over 61% of essays written by non-native English speakers as AI-generated, compared to near-perfect accuracy on native speaker essays.
mechanism_atoms: Detectors produce contested false positives (esp. non-native writers); the actual academic-integrity decision requires a human to weigh context, stylistic evidence, and appeals - the judgment call is irreducibly manual.
concepts.open_problem: Detectors produce contested false positives (esp. non-native writers); the actual academic-integrity decision requires a human to weigh context, stylistic evidence, and appeals - the judgment call is irreducibly manual.

concepts.name: Curriculum sequencing / knowledge-dependency mapping
concepts.summary_verbatim: Developing learning progressions should be a collaborative effort among teachers, curriculum developers, and subject matter experts.
mechanism_atoms: Mapping prerequisite knowledge dependencies and sequencing concepts (concrete-before-abstract, cognitive-load pacing) is a consensus-building expert task; adaptive engines reorder existing items but the dependency graph + progression design is human.
concepts.open_problem: Mapping prerequisite knowledge dependencies and sequencing concepts (concrete-before-abstract, cognitive-load pacing) is a consensus-building expert task; adaptive engines reorder existing items but the dependency graph + progression design is human.

concepts.name: Rail dispatching real-time conflict resolution
concepts.summary_verbatim: The task of conflict resolution in railway dispatching is still completely under manual control of human dispatchers, though visualization tools and other systems exist to assist them.
mechanism_atoms: Resolving train conflicts (re-ordering, re-routing, knock-on delay tradeoffs across territory boundaries) is still almost entirely manual; dispatchers rely on experience and limited inputs, often ignoring network-wide knock-on effects.
concepts.open_problem: Resolving train conflicts (re-ordering, re-routing, knock-on delay tradeoffs across territory boundaries) is still almost entirely manual; dispatchers rely on experience and limited inputs, often ignoring network-wide knock-on effects.

concepts.name: Grid black-start / restoration sequencing operator judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: Grid operators have to be very deliberate about how many customers they restore service to at a time.
mechanism_atoms: Selecting among black-start plans, island formation order, and frequency/phase-matched re-synchronization under cold-load-pickup uncertainty is a high-stakes, deliberate human decision; plans are pre-built but live execution choices are operator judgment.
concepts.open_problem: Selecting among black-start plans, island formation order, and frequency/phase-matched re-synchronization under cold-load-pickup uncertainty is a high-stakes, deliberate human decision; plans are pre-built but live execution choices are operator judgment.

concepts.name: Traffic-signal retiming engineering
concepts.summary_verbatim: A signal retiming program should take around 20 to 25 staff hours per intersection.
mechanism_atoms: Retiming intersections is staff-hour heavy (20-25 hrs/intersection) and gated by engineer scarcity; while data collection is being automated, the timing-plan engineering judgment per corridor is still manual and under-staffed.
concepts.open_problem: Retiming intersections is staff-hour heavy (20-25 hrs/intersection) and gated by engineer scarcity; while data collection is being automated, the timing-plan engineering judgment per corridor is still manual and under-staffed.

concepts.name: Water-network leak pinpointing (acoustic field judgment)
concepts.summary_verbatim: The acoustic listening method manually conducted by waterworks operators during routine leak pinpointing tasks is typically labor-intensive, skill-dependent, non-systematic, and sometimes imprecise due to fatigue and inexperience of newly trained staff.
mechanism_atoms: Final pinpointing of a leak by acoustic listening is skill-dependent, non-systematic, and degrades with operator fatigue/inexperience; the interpretive 'is that the leak' call in the field is still human.
concepts.open_problem: Final pinpointing of a leak by acoustic listening is skill-dependent, non-systematic, and degrades with operator fatigue/inexperience; the interpretive 'is that the leak' call in the field is still human.

concepts.name: Event-based surveillance signal triage (manual cluster verification)
concepts.summary_verbatim: amongst 43,631 raw signals detected, 138 (0.3%) were escalated; 63 (46%) of those were verified as events
mechanism_atoms: Epidemiologists manually read large volumes of unstructured signals (media, rumors, reports) and decide which tiny fraction to escalate/verify as real events; the cluster triage step is still primarily manual and only ~0.3% of raw signals get escalated, demanding human judgment on what 'unusual' means in local context.
concepts.open_problem: Epidemiologists manually read large volumes of unstructured signals (media, rumors, reports) and decide which tiny fraction to escalate/verify as real events; the cluster triage step is still primarily manual and only ~0.3% of raw signals get escalated, demanding human judgment on what 'unusual' means in local context.

concepts.name: Foodborne outbreak hypothesis generation from trawling interviews
concepts.summary_verbatim: These procedures are labour-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to error.
mechanism_atoms: After a cluster is flagged, epidemiologists conduct open-ended 'trawling' interviews asking sick people about every food/restaurant/event, then subjectively generate a hypothesis for the likely vehicle; this is labour-intensive, time-consuming, error-prone, and most outbreak vehicles remain unidentified. The judgment of forming the right hypothesis from sparse, noisy recall is the gap.
concepts.open_problem: After a cluster is flagged, epidemiologists conduct open-ended 'trawling' interviews asking sick people about every food/restaurant/event, then subjectively generate a hypothesis for the likely vehicle; this is labour-intensive, time-consuming, error-prone, and most outbreak vehicles remain unidentified. The judgment of forming the right hypothesis from sparse, noisy recall is the gap.

concepts.name: Wilderness SAR probability-of-area (POA) consensus estimation
concepts.summary_verbatim: the consensus method of developing a search plan does not appear to adequately address one particular bias
mechanism_atoms: Ground search planners assign subjective probabilities to map segments (where is the lost person) via a 'Mattson Consensus' averaging exercise; these human probability judgments are demonstrably affected by cognitive biases (e.g., anchoring) that the consensus method does not fully correct, and there is no standard algorithm replacing the expert judgment call for terrestrial searches.
concepts.open_problem: Ground search planners assign subjective probabilities to map segments (where is the lost person) via a 'Mattson Consensus' averaging exercise; these human probability judgments are demonstrably affected by cognitive biases (e.g., anchoring) that the consensus method does not fully correct, and there is no standard algorithm replacing the expert judgment call for terrestrial searches.

concepts.name: Disaster relief supply pre-positioning / staging decisions
concepts.summary_verbatim: As Incident Commander, one of the most daunting tasks ahead is the management of incoming resources and deployment in accordance with YOUR plan.
mechanism_atoms: Incident commanders and emergency managers decide what relief resources to pre-position where and when before/at the start of an event, and how to deploy the flood of incoming aid; in practice this is driven by the IC's plan, experience, and judgment under deep uncertainty rather than a standard optimizer integrated into the field workflow.
concepts.open_problem: Incident commanders and emergency managers decide what relief resources to pre-position where and when before/at the start of an event, and how to deploy the flood of incoming aid; in practice this is driven by the IC's plan, experience, and judgment under deep uncertainty rather than a standard optimizer integrated into the field workflow.

concepts.name: Vaccine cold-chain temperature-excursion disposition judgment
concepts.summary_verbatim: 91% of staff believed that they did not have the necessary tools to detect if a vaccine had been damaged by a temperature excursion
mechanism_atoms: When a temperature excursion occurs, frontline staff must judge whether vaccines are still usable or damaged (freezing can be as harmful as heat); a large majority report they lack the tools to make this call, leaving a manual, error-prone disposition decision at the point of care.
concepts.open_problem: When a temperature excursion occurs, frontline staff must judge whether vaccines are still usable or damaged (freezing can be as harmful as heat); a large majority report they lack the tools to make this call, leaving a manual, error-prone disposition decision at the point of care.

concepts.name: Wastewater surveillance signal interpretation
concepts.summary_verbatim: it is very difficult for public health officials to interpret and use viral RNA or DNA concentrations in wastewater for decision-making purposes
mechanism_atoms: Translating raw viral RNA/DNA concentrations in sewage into actionable public-health meaning (rising? real? what population? what action?) requires expert judgment because shedding rates/timing vary by pathogen and sewersheds don't map to political boundaries; officials find it very difficult to interpret for decision-making.
concepts.open_problem: Translating raw viral RNA/DNA concentrations in sewage into actionable public-health meaning (rising? real? what population? what action?) requires expert judgment because shedding rates/timing vary by pathogen and sewersheds don't map to political boundaries; officials find it very difficult to interpret for decision-making.

concepts.name: Dynamic ambulance relocation between calls
concepts.summary_verbatim: the commonly used method to recover from disturbances in practice is to change deployment manually based on experiences and professional judgements
mechanism_atoms: Dispatchers/supervisors decide where to move idle ambulances to wait for the next emergency and which unit to send; in real operations relocation is commonly changed manually based on experience and professional judgment despite a large optimization literature, with persistent gaps in patient-outcome-aware and rural deployment.
concepts.open_problem: Dispatchers/supervisors decide where to move idle ambulances to wait for the next emergency and which unit to send; in real operations relocation is commonly changed manually based on experience and professional judgment despite a large optimization literature, with persistent gaps in patient-outcome-aware and rural deployment.

concepts.name: 911 / emergency call risk triage and prioritization
concepts.summary_verbatim: Machine Learning can support the professional judgement of experienced human operators with a precise, low-latency forecast of call risk
mechanism_atoms: Call-takers assess urgency and decide unit response from speech, noise, and context; the field has explicitly settled on a human-in-the-loop model where empathy/intuition stay with humans, so the judgment-heavy triage call is deliberately only AI-assisted, not automated.
concepts.open_problem: Call-takers assess urgency and decide unit response from speech, noise, and context; the field has explicitly settled on a human-in-the-loop model where empathy/intuition stay with humans, so the judgment-heavy triage call is deliberately only AI-assisted, not automated.

concepts.name: 911 call empathy/judgment triage on degraded audio
concepts.summary_verbatim: The technology often struggles with background noise, accents, trauma responses, or speech related to medical conditions.
mechanism_atoms: Deciding acuity and whether to involve law enforcement when callers are panicked, accented, traumatized, or in noisy environments — the empathy/intuition layer where AI fails and a human must weigh ambiguous spoken cues in real time.
concepts.open_problem: Deciding acuity and whether to involve law enforcement when callers are panicked, accented, traumatized, or in noisy environments — the empathy/intuition layer where AI fails and a human must weigh ambiguous spoken cues in real time.

concepts.name: EMD acuity determination / over-undertriage tuning
concepts.summary_verbatim: Overtriage occurs when patients are triaged on-scene by EMS staff as lower acuity but were dispatched as high priority (P1).
mechanism_atoms: Closing the gap between dispatch-assigned priority and on-scene reality; Medical Priority Dispatch protocols overtriage at ~62% (target 25-35%) — a structured-protocol-plus-human-judgment task to right-size ambulance acuity that resists pure automation.
concepts.open_problem: Closing the gap between dispatch-assigned priority and on-scene reality; Medical Priority Dispatch protocols overtriage at ~62% (target 25-35%) — a structured-protocol-plus-human-judgment task to right-size ambulance acuity that resists pure automation.

concepts.name: SAR mission tasking & search-segment prioritization
concepts.summary_verbatim: The SAR Incident Commander is responsible for the coordination and control of all incident activities and the associated minute-by-minute decisions, and is accountable for the overall success or failure of the mission.
mechanism_atoms: The IC's minute-by-minute call of which segment to assign which arriving resource — translating Lost Person Behavior probability into segment tasking and dynamic re-tasking remains manual map-work and human judgment, not optimization.
concepts.open_problem: The IC's minute-by-minute call of which segment to assign which arriving resource — translating Lost Person Behavior probability into segment tasking and dynamic re-tasking remains manual map-work and human judgment, not optimization.

concepts.name: Wildfire incident-command resource staging decisions
concepts.summary_verbatim: Fire operations doctrine does not consist of procedures to be applied to specific situations so much as it sets forth general guidance that requires judgment.
mechanism_atoms: Recognition-primed IC choices on where to stage and pre-position crews/engines under fast-changing fire behavior — doctrine explicitly demands judgment, not procedure, leaving the staging/mobilization-center allocation call essentially un-automated.
concepts.open_problem: Recognition-primed IC choices on where to stage and pre-position crews/engines under fast-changing fire behavior — doctrine explicitly demands judgment, not procedure, leaving the staging/mobilization-center allocation call essentially un-automated.

concepts.name: Disaster preliminary damage assessment field verification
concepts.summary_verbatim: Visual interpretation is very important as well as the experience of the map provider in order to contain as much as possible the limitations of the automatic processing.
mechanism_atoms: Human ground-truth validation of damage severity that feeds Presidential-declaration eligibility — even with imagery/Survey123, field assessors must adjudicate damage categories per-structure, a judgment + verification gap remote sensing alone can't close.
concepts.open_problem: Human ground-truth validation of damage severity that feeds Presidential-declaration eligibility — even with imagery/Survey123, field assessors must adjudicate damage categories per-structure, a judgment + verification gap remote sensing alone can't close.

concepts.name: Outbreak rumor/signal verification (true-vs-noise triage)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Human input plays a crucial role for data curation and signal verification.
mechanism_atoms: Epidemiologists manually verifying whether an unofficial outbreak rumor is real before triggering costly response — true events verified in ~2.7 days, false rumors ~9.3 days; the curation/verification judgment is human and slow.
concepts.open_problem: Epidemiologists manually verifying whether an unofficial outbreak rumor is real before triggering costly response — true events verified in ~2.7 days, false rumors ~9.3 days; the curation/verification judgment is human and slow.

concepts.name: Syndromic-surveillance alarm adjudication (Alert/Monitor/No-action)
concepts.summary_verbatim: Syndromic surveillance systems have to follow up alarms with a second stage process to determine whether individual alarms are of potential public health importance.
mechanism_atoms: After low-threshold statistical alarms fire (high false-positive rates), an epidemiologist must do a second-stage manual review and assign Alert/Monitor/No-action — the contextual public-health-significance call is still human.
concepts.open_problem: After low-threshold statistical alarms fire (high false-positive rates), an epidemiologist must do a second-stage manual review and assign Alert/Monitor/No-action — the contextual public-health-significance call is still human.

concepts.name: Wastewater signal interpretation -> public-health action
concepts.summary_verbatim: Various methods are employed to draw inferences ... from tests of statistical significance to application of expert judgment. However, these analyses require skills that are not always readily available within the jurisdiction or local public health department.
mechanism_atoms: Turning noisy multi-site wastewater pathogen-load data into an actionable 'worsening trend / act now' call — explicitly mixes statistics with expert judgment, and local depts often lack the skills, so the interpretation step is a manual bottleneck.
concepts.open_problem: Turning noisy multi-site wastewater pathogen-load data into an actionable 'worsening trend / act now' call — explicitly mixes statistics with expert judgment, and local depts often lack the skills, so the interpretation step is a manual bottleneck.

concepts.name: Contact-tracing interview prioritization sequencing
concepts.summary_verbatim: A crucial decision in any contact tracing strategy is which person should a tracer trace next, given a set of contacts.
mechanism_atoms: Which contact to interview next given limited tracers — a sequential decision with downstream branching effects (querying B vs C changes future options); currently a heuristic human call, only recently framed as a 'branching bandit' optimization.
concepts.open_problem: Which contact to interview next given limited tracers — a sequential decision with downstream branching effects (querying B vs C changes future options); currently a heuristic human call, only recently framed as a 'branching bandit' optimization.

concepts.name: Risk-based health-inspection targeting
concepts.summary_verbatim: Health inspection frequency depends on several factors reflecting an establishment's risk profile, with high-risk operations typically facing inspections every 6-12 months.
mechanism_atoms: Allocating scarce inspectors by establishment risk — frequency still driven by static risk tiers + inspection history + complaint volume rather than dynamic predictive targeting in most jurisdictions.
concepts.open_problem: Allocating scarce inspectors by establishment risk — frequency still driven by static risk tiers + inspection history + complaint volume rather than dynamic predictive targeting in most jurisdictions.

concepts.name: Vaccine cold-chain temperature-excursion disposition call
concepts.summary_verbatim: The sustainable last-mile cold chain logistics operations of COVID-19 vaccines is a complex short-term planning problem that faces many practical challenges.
mechanism_atoms: After an excursion, deciding whether product is still usable vs must be discarded, and re-routing last-mile under supply uncertainty — stability-budget judgment that's partly procedural but still a human disposition decision at the point of delivery.
concepts.open_problem: After an excursion, deciding whether product is still usable vs must be discarded, and re-routing last-mile under supply uncertainty — stability-budget judgment that's partly procedural but still a human disposition decision at the point of delivery.
